task.description: WF-03 Step 2: produce the design artefact for ISS-0710 / GH-797 — the ORCH dispatch-time staleness gate. The fix (docs/process change, no production code) is fully specified in the Step 1 result and inner report: add a dispatch-time short-circuit check so an ADHOC run never reaches step-00 against an already-completed target. Design artefact must cover: (1) ORCHESTRATOR.md §5 construction rule 7 — dispatch-time end-state precondition; (2) new ORCHESTRATOR.md §8f 'Dispatch-Time Staleness Check — BEFORE an ADHOC run's Step 00' mirroring the §8a/§8e shape (exit-code-only verdict, log line on both branches); (3) the check mechanics: `git fetch origin`, then per-target requirement ID read status at origin/main via `python tools/reqctl.py show <id>` (or `git show origin/main:docs/requirements.yaml` + parse); compare against the ADHOC's declared desired end-state; (4) short-circuit behavior: if ANY target already at desired end-state at origin/main HEAD, ORCH does NOT create/dispatch step-00 (no branch, no stash), aborts with result.status BLOCKED + BLOCKER issue entry naming the already-done IDs and the delivering run/PR, and logs `<ts> | DISPATCH_STALE | <run-id> | --- | ORCH | BLOCKER — target already at <status> at origin/main HEAD (<delivering run/PR>) — ADHOC short-circuited before step-00`; (5) keep the existing in-run pre-flight as defense-in-depth for the dispatch-to-execution race; (6) mirror into .claude/agents/orchestrator.md and the GitHub-harness adapters .github/instructions/orchestrator.instructions.md + .github/agents/orchestrator.agent.md per AGENT_SYSTEM.md §9 (A007 — adapters must not drift). Write the design to src/design/iss0710-gh797-dispatch-staleness-gate.md.
acceptance_criteria: src/design/iss0710-gh797-dispatch-staleness-gate.md created and passes tools/lint_design_artefact.py (BLOCKER=0 MAJOR=0) if the linter applies to a process/docs design (check first)
Design covers all six elements in task.description (rule 7, §8f, check mechanics, short-circuit behavior, defense-in-depth, adapter mirroring)
No implementation code written (design only; implementation is Step 3)
Exact wording for the §8f section and the DISPATCH_STALE log line specified
